# bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/mdrun

## Summary

Wrapper of the GROMACS mdrun module.

MDRun is the main computational chemistry engine within GROMACS. It performs Molecular Dynamics simulations, but it can also perform Stochastic Dynamics, Energy Minimization, test particle insertion or (re)calculation of energies.

Nextflow adapter of the [Mdrun](https://biobb-gromacs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/gromacs.html#module-gromacs.mdrun) building block of [biobb_gromacs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_gromacs) 5.3.2.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_GROMACS_MDRUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_gromacs/mdrun'

workflow {
    BIOBB_GROMACS_MDRUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_tpr_path` | yes | tpr | Path to the portable binary run input file TPR |
| `input_cpt_path` | no | cpt | Path to the input GROMACS checkpoint file CPT |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_gro_path` | yes | gro | Path to the output GROMACS structure GRO file |
| `output_edr_path` | yes | edr | Path to the output GROMACS portable energy file EDR |
| `output_log_path` | yes | log | Path to the output GROMACS trajectory log file LOG |
| `output_trr_path` | no, opt-in | trr | Path to the GROMACS uncompressed raw trajectory file TRR |
| `output_xtc_path` | no, opt-in | xtc | Path to the GROMACS compressed trajectory file XTC |
| `output_cpt_path` | no, opt-in | cpt | Path to the output GROMACS checkpoint file CPT |
| `output_dhdl_path` | no, opt-in | xvg | Path to the output dhdl.xvg file only used when free energy calculation is turned on |
| `versions_biobb_gromacs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_gromacs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Mdrun properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false, num_threads: task.cpus]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_trr_path: 'trr']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_gromacs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_GROMACS_MDRUN' {
        ext.properties = [mpi_np: 0]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mpi_bin` | string | null | Path to the MPI runner. Usually "mpirun" or "srun". |
| `mpi_np` | integer | 0 | Number of MPI processes. Usually an integer bigger than 1. |
| `mpi_flags` | string | null | Path to the MPI hostlist file. |
| `checkpoint_time` | integer | 15 | Checkpoint writing interval in minutes. Only enabled if an output_cpt_path is provided. |
| `noappend` | boolean | false | Include the noappend flag to open new output files and add the simulation part number to all output file names |
| `num_threads` | integer | 0 | Let GROMACS guess. The number of threads that are going to be used. |
| `num_threads_mpi` | integer | 0 | Let GROMACS guess. The number of GROMACS MPI threads per rank that are going to be used. |
| `num_threads_omp` | integer | 0 | Let GROMACS guess. The number of GROMACS OPENMP threads per MPI rank that are going to be used. |
| `num_threads_omp_pme` | integer | 0 | Let GROMACS guess. The number of GROMACS OPENMP_PME threads per MPI rank that are going to be used. |
| `use_gpu` | boolean | false | Use settings appropriate for GPU. Adds: -nb gpu -pme gpu |
| `gpu_id` | string | null | list of unique GPU device IDs available to use. |
| `gpu_tasks` | string | null | list of GPU device IDs, mapping each PP task on each node to a device. |
| `gmx_lib` | string | null | Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable. |
| `binary_path` | string | "gmx" | Path to the GROMACS executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
